title: 108 சரஸ்வதி போற்றி | Saraswathi 108 Potri Cinematic Devotional Film
description:
A full-length image-based Amman film set to the original Guru Kula Desam 108 Saraswathi Potri recording. Twelve distinct scenes begin with a wide temple and lotus-lake view for the orchestral opening. Paired lit dheepam and four slowly burning agarbaththi sticks frame each lower corner with gentle white-grey smoke. Restrained drizzle appears only on the wet outdoor shrine path, and the Guru Kula Desam emblem stays at lower left.

Original song and audio: https://youtu.be/94drEh5bkH0
Music: Guru Kula Desam

#GuruKulaDesam #Saraswathi #Amman #TamilDevotional
